description: An object of the event client type represents one event client.
For more information about the event client interface see the documentation in
source/libs/evc/sge_event_client.cc

attributes.name: id
description: Unique id requested by client or given by qmaster

attributes.name: name
description: name of event client (non unique)

attributes.name: host
description: Commlib address: The host name where the event client is running

attributes.name: commproc
description: Commlib address: The process name, e.g. qsub for the qsub -sync y event client

attributes.name: commid
description: Commlib address: A unique id assigned by the sge_qmaster commlib

attributes.name: uid
description: The user id of the user who started the event client.

attributes.name: d_time
description: The time interval in seconds in which an event package is delivered to the client.

attributes.name: subscribed
description: a list of subscribed events

attributes.name: changed
description: true, if any configuration information of the event client has been changed.
Requires then updating the event client information in the event master

attributes.name: busy_handling
description: Defines how the event master shall deal with busy event clients.

attributes.name: session
description: Session key used tfor filtering subscribed events, used with job submission via the DRMAA interface

attributes.name: last_heard_from
description: Timestamp (microseconds since epoch) of the last communication between event client and event master.

attributes.name: last_send_time
description: Timestamp (microseconds since epoch) when the last event package was sent to the event client.

attributes.name: next_send_time
description: Timestamp (microseconds since epoch) when the next event package shall be sent to the event client.

attributes.name: next_number
description: Serial number of the next event which will be sent to the event client.

attributes.name: busy
description: true if the event client is considered busy, else false.
no events will be sent to a busy client

attributes.name: events
description: List of events which will next be delivered to the event client.

attributes.name: sub_array
description: Subscription information used in event master only.

attributes.name: state
description: State of the event client, e.g. connected, closing, terminated.

attributes.name: update_function
description: Pointer to an update function used for updating internal event clients (threads in sge_qmaster).

attributes.name: update_function_arg
description: Pointer that is passed to the update_function when it is called.
The pointer can be specified during mirror/evc initialize.
